issues.body: The module now explicitly states that it has no caller and changes no orchestration behavior. The diff adds only the pure decision module, its self-test-suite entry, and a park cause; it changes no workflow or existing orchestration caller. Consequently no terminal review-loop park or existing review:needs-user backlog item can collect trusted facts, resolve and assert the opposite-provider judge, invoke adjudication, call decide(), apply an exact-head-bound label/state transition, or write the receipt used for termination. The self-tests validate helpers in isolation but cannot demonstrate the feature operating on a PR.
issues.fix_hint: Add the actual review-loop and bounded backlog-sweep integration, including fail-closed account/token resolution, exact head/base binding, proof of machine-owned labels and trusted receipts, honest trust-surface/security/gate-weakening classification, guarded transitions, and end-to-end tests of those callers.
issues.title: The adjudicator still has no executable orchestration path

verdict.summary: Round 2 fixes both prior fail-closed decision-plane defects: marker absence is now distinguished from corrupt/unknown markers with counterfactual tests, and every final return-to-loop outcome now requires a concrete fix sketch. However, the prior blocker remains explicitly acknowledged by the new module itself: there is still no workflow or orchestration caller, so this change cannot adjudicate any terminal park or backlog item. The pure helpers and self-tests are substantial and non-vacuous, but the claimed stuck-escalation feature remains incomplete until its authority-bearing collection, cross-provider invocation, SHA-bound transition, and durable receipt path are integrated and tested.
